rules: Function classification is judgment and lives in this file. Path existence and file counts are computed by verify_map.py, never typed by hand.
No path is moved by anything in this package. This is a map, not a migration.
A component classified historical is preserved and read-only. It is not deleted.

targets.control: Objectives, schedules, policy, run governance. What the system decides to do today.
targets.acquisition: Supply, discovery, triggers, market and ICP selection. What enters the pipeline.
targets.evidence: Sources, claims, ledgers, provenance, staleness. What may be said and cited.
targets.opportunities: Canonical prospect identity, qualification, routing, diagnostic selection, lifecycle state.
targets.approvals: Approval packets, exact copy, destinations, digests, external-action gates.
targets.learning: Scorecards, conversion reporting, experiment outcomes, run reports.
targets.adapters: Read and write bridges to tools and other stores. No business truth lives here.
